  1: # 💻 Ayan Maiti | Developer Portfolio
  2: 
  3: <div align="center">
  4:   <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/React-61DAFB?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=black" alt="React"/>
  5:   <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-F7DF1E?style=for-the-badge&logo=javascript&logoColor=black" alt="JavaScript"/>

  7:   <img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-339933?style=for-the-badge&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white" alt="Node.js"/>

  9: </div>
 10: 
 11: <div align="center">
 12:   <h3><a href="https://moonman.in" target="_blank">✨ Live Demo: moonman.in</a></h3>
 13: </div>
 14: 
 15: <p align="center">
 16:   <img src="https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/1352/1352280.png" alt="Portfolio Banner" width="40%"/>
 17: </p>
 18: 
 19: ## 📋 Overview
 20: 
 21: A modern, responsive developer portfolio website showcasing my skills, projects, and professional experience. The site features a sleek, dark-themed UI with Matrix-inspired interactive elements, dynamic GitHub and LeetCode stat integration, and a comprehensive display of my work in full-stack and blockchain development.
 22: 
 23: ## ✨ Features
 24: 
 25: - **🎯 Interactive UI**: Sleek, responsive design with Matrix-inspired animations
 26: - **📊 Live Stats Integration**: Real-time display of GitHub and LeetCode statistics
 27: - **🚀 Project Showcase**: Comprehensive portfolio section featuring my latest work
 28: - **📝 Skills & Experience**: Detailed breakdown of technical skills and competencies
 29: - **📱 Fully Responsive**: Optimized for all device sizes with adaptive layouts
 30: - **📬 Contact Form**: Integrated email contact functionality
 31: - **📜 Resume/CV**: Direct download access to my latest CV
 32: 
 33: ## 🛠️ Technologies Used
 34: 
 35: ### Frontend
 36: 
 37: - React.js
 38: - CSS3 with custom animations
 39: - React Icons
 40: - React Circular Progressbar
 41: - React Notifications
 42: - Email.js for contact form
 43: 
 44: ### Backend/API Integration
 45: 
 46: - Node.js
 47: - Express.js
 48: - HTTP Proxy Middleware
 49: - GitHub API (via Octokit)
 50: - LeetCode API
 51: - Geolocation API
 52: 
 53: ### State Management & Utilities
 54: 
 55: - React Hooks
 56: - React Cookies
 57: - Axios for HTTP requests
 58: 
 59: ## 🔍 Core Components
 60: 
 61: - **Header**: Main introduction with animated elements
 62: - **About**: Personal background and quick statistics
 63: - **Experience**: Detailed skills breakdown by category
 64: - **Stats**: GitHub, LeetCode, and certification showcase
 65: - **Portfolio**: Showcase of recent projects with live demos
 66: - **Contact**: Multiple contact methods and form
 67: 
 68: ## 🌐 API Integrations
 69: 
 70: - **GitHub API**: Fetches repositories, commits, PRs, and stars
 71: - **LeetCode API**: Retrieves coding problem statistics
 72: - **Geolocation API**: Detects user location for enhanced experience
 73: 
 74: ## 🧩 Project Structure
 75: 
 76: ```
 77: /
 78: ├── public/               # Static files
 79: ├── src/                  # Source files
 80: │   ├── assets/           # Images and static resources
 81: │   ├── components/       # UI components
 82: │   │   ├── about/        # About section
 83: │   │   ├── contact/      # Contact section
 84: │   │   ├── experience/   # Experience section
 85: │   │   ├── footer/       # Footer component
 86: │   │   ├── header/       # Header & hero section
 87: │   │   ├── matrix-rain/  # Matrix animation effect
 88: │   │   ├── nav/          # Navigation component
 89: │   │   ├── portfolio/    # Portfolio showcase
 90: │   │   ├── stats/        # GitHub & LeetCode stats
 91: │   │   └── testimonials/ # Testimonials section
 92: │   ├── App.jsx           # Main application component
 93: │   ├── index.js          # Application entry point
 94: │   ├── index.css         # Global styles
 95: │   └── setupProxy.js     # API proxy configuration
 96: └── package.json          # Project dependencies
 97: ```
 98: 
 99: ## 🚀 Getting Started
100: 
101: ### Prerequisites
102: 
103: - Node.js (v14+)
104: - npm or yarn
105: 
106: ### Installation
107: 
108: 1. Clone the repository
109: 
110:    ```bash
111:    git clone https://github.com/moonman369/Portfolio.git
112:    cd Portfolio
113:    ```
114: 
115: 2. Install dependencies
116: 
117:    ```bash
118:    npm install
119:    # or
120:    yarn install
121:    ```
122: 
123: 3. Create a `.env` file in the root directory with your API keys:
124: 
125:    ```
126:    REACT_APP_GITHUB_PAT=your_github_personal_access_token
127:    REACT_APP_USERNAME=your_github_username
128:    REACT_APP_API_KEY=your_geolocation_api_key
129:    REACT_APP_PORTFOLIO_API_HOSTNAME=your_api_hostname
130:    REACT_APP_PORTFOLIO_API_LEETCODE_ENDPOINT=your_leetcode_endpoint
131:    REACT_APP_PORTFOLIO_API_GITHUB_ENDPOINT=your_github_endpoint
132:    ```
133: 
134: 4. Start the development server
135: 
136:    ```bash
137:    npm start
138:    # or
139:    yarn start
140:    ```
141: 
142: 5. Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser
143: 
144: ### Building for Production
145: 
146: ```bash
147: npm run build
148: # or
149: yarn build
150: ```

  1: import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
  2: import useInterval from "@use-it/interval";
  3: 
  4: // Constants
  5: const VALID_CHARS = `アァカサタナハマヤャラワガザダバパイィキシチニヒミリヰギジヂビピウゥクスツヌフムユュルグズブヅプエェケセテネヘメレヱゲゼデベペオォコソトノホモヨョロヲゴゾドボポヴッンABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ1234567890!@#$%^&*()_+~}{|:?><''\"`;
  6: const STREAM_MUTATION_ODDS = 0.05;
  7: 
  8: const MIN_STREAM_SIZE = 70;
  9: const MAX_STREAM_SIZE = 110;
 10: 
 11: const MIN_INTERVAL_DELAY = 40;
 12: const MAX_INTERVAL_DELAY = 90;
 13: 
 14: const MIN_DELAY_BETWEEN_STREAMS = 0;
 15: const MAX_DELAY_BETWEEN_STREAMS = 8000;
 16: 
 17: const getRandInRange = (min, max) =>
 18:   Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min)) + min;
 19: 
 20: const getRandChar = () =>
 21:   VALID_CHARS.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * VALID_CHARS.length));
 22: 
 23: const getRandStream = () =>
 24:   new Array(getRandInRange(MIN_STREAM_SIZE, MAX_STREAM_SIZE))
 25:     .fill()
 26:     .map((_) => getRandChar());
 27: 
 28: const getMutatedStream = (stream) => {
 29:   const newStream = [];
 30:   for (let i = 1; i < stream.length; i++) {
 31:     if (Math.random() < STREAM_MUTATION_ODDS) {
 32:       newStream.push(getRandChar());
 33:     } else {
 34:       newStream.push(stream[i]);
 35:     }
 36:   }
 37:   newStream.push(getRandChar());
 38:   return newStream;
 39: };
 40: 
 41: const RainStream = (props) => {
 42:   const [stream, setStream] = useState(getRandStream());
 43:   const [topPadding, setTopPadding] = useState(stream.length * -20);
 44:   const [intervalDelay, setIntervalDelay] = useState(null);
 45: 
 46:   // Initialize intervalDelay
 47:   useEffect(() => {
 48:     setTimeout(() => {
 49:       setIntervalDelay(getRandInRange(MIN_INTERVAL_DELAY, MAX_INTERVAL_DELAY));
 50:     }, getRandInRange(MIN_DELAY_BETWEEN_STREAMS, MAX_DELAY_BETWEEN_STREAMS));
 51:   }, []);
 52: 
 53:   useInterval(() => {
 54:     if (!props.height) return;
 55: 
 56:     if (!intervalDelay) return;
 57: 
 58:     // If stream is off the screen, reset it after timeout
 59:     if (topPadding > props.height) {
 60:       setStream([]);
 61:       const newStream = getRandStream();
 62:       setStream(newStream);
 63:       setTopPadding(newStream.length * -30);
 64:       setIntervalDelay(null);
 65:       setTimeout(
 66:         () =>
 67:           setIntervalDelay(
 68:             getRandInRange(MIN_INTERVAL_DELAY, MAX_INTERVAL_DELAY)
 69:           ),
 70:         getRandInRange(MIN_DELAY_BETWEEN_STREAMS, MAX_DELAY_BETWEEN_STREAMS)
 71:       );
 72:     } else {
 73:       setTopPadding(topPadding + 50);
 74:     }
 75:     // setStream(stream => [...stream.slice(1, stream.length), getRandChar()]);
 76:     setStream(getMutatedStream);
 77:   }, intervalDelay);
 78: 
 79:   return (
 80:     <div
 81:       style={{
 82:         fontFamily: "matrixFont",
 83:         color: "#20c20e",
 84:         writingMode: "vertical-rl",
 85:         textOrientation: "upright",
 86:         userSelect: "none",
 87:         whiteSpace: "nowrap",
 88:         marginTop: topPadding,
 89:         marginLeft: -12,
 90:         marginRight: -12,
 91:         textShadow: `0px 0px 9px rgba(75, 213, 255, 1)`,
 92:         fontSize: 16,
 93:       }}
 94:     >
 95:       {stream.map((char, index) => (
 96:         <a
 97:           style={{
 98:             marginTop: -5,
 99:             // Reduce opacity for last chars
100:             opacity: index < stream.length - 5 ? 0.1 + index * 0.15 : 1,
101:             color: index === stream.length - 1 ? "#fff" : undefined,
102:             textShadow:
103:               index === stream.length - 1
104:                 ? "0px 10px 30px rgb(255, 255, 255)"
105:                 : undefined,
106:           }}
107:         >
108:           {char}
109:         </a>
110:       ))}
111:     </div>
112:   );
113: };
114: 
115: const MatrixRain = (props) => {
116:   const containerRef = useRef(null);
117:   const [containerSize, setContainerSize] = useState(null); // ?{width, height}
118: 
119:   useEffect(() => {
120:     const boundingClientRect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
121:     setContainerSize({
122:       width: boundingClientRect.width,
123:       height: boundingClientRect.height,
124:     });
125:   }, []);
126: 
127:   const streamCount = containerSize ? Math.floor(window.innerWidth / 75) : 0;
128: 
129:   return (
130:     <div
131:       className={props.customClass}
132:       style={{
133:         background: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
134:         backgroundImage: "url(../src/assets/bg-texture.png)",
135:         position: "fixed",
136:         top: 0,
137:         left: 0,
138:         bottom: 0,
139:         right: 0,
140:         overflow: "ignore",
141:         display: "flex",
142:         flexDirection: "row",
143:         justifyContent: "space-between",
144:         transition: "all 1000ms",
145:       }}
146:       ref={containerRef}
147:     >
148:       {new Array(streamCount).fill().map((_) => (
149:         <>
150:           <RainStream height={containerSize?.height} />
151:           <RainStream height={containerSize?.height} />
152:           <RainStream height={containerSize?.height} />
153:           <RainStream height={containerSize?.height} />
154:         </>
155:       ))}
156:     </div>
157:   );
158: };
159: 
160: export default MatrixRain;

11:     if (req.method == "OPTIONS") {
12:       res.status(HttpStatusCode.Ok);
13:     }
14:   });
15:

17:     createProxyMiddleware("/graphql", {
18:       target: "https://leetcode.com",
19:       changeOrigin: true,
20:     })
21:   );
22:
